## Stop Before Posting

Do **not** publish vulnerability details, exploits, credentials, personal data, source locations, or unredacted evidence in this issue.

Use GitHub Private vulnerability reporting if enabled for the repository. Otherwise contact the repository owner through a private method shown on the owner's GitHub profile. See `SECURITY.md`.

If no private channel is available, open only a minimal issue asking the owner to enable a secure reporting channel. Do not include technical details.
